title: pvHyperTreeGridDepthLimiter
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridDepthLimiter

Truncates a hyper tree grid at a maximum refinement depth: cells at depth SetDepth become leaves and finer levels are dropped, giving a coarser view of an adaptively refined grid. Depth counts from 0 at the root cells; if it is at least the grid's deepest level, the output equals the input. With a material mask present, ParaView notes that the output extent can be larger than the input's.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView's static SetDepth is 0, which keeps only the root (coarsest) cells; set the level you want.
- Truncated cells show the values already stored on coarse cells; run pvHyperTreeGridEvaluateCoarse first if they should summarise their children.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridDepthLimiter`. Identity: `filters/HyperTreeGridDepthLimiter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
